words.enDefinition: items that make a room usable or comfortable

examples.en: The apartment comes with basic furnishings, but we still need a dining table.
examples.zh: 公寓配了基本的「室内陈设」，不过我们还需要一张餐桌。

examples.en: The residence adviser showed us which furnishings belonged to the university when we moved in.
examples.zh: 我们搬进去时，宿舍管理员告诉我们哪些「室内陈设」是学校的。

words.enDefinition: put furniture and other useful items into a room

examples.en: I never expected it to cost this much to furnish a room near campus.
examples.zh: 没想到在学校附近「给房间配家具」要花这么多钱。

examples.en: You can furnish a room cheaply if you start with the student swap group.
examples.zh: 可以先去学生交换群看看，这样「给房间配家具」能省不少钱。

collocations: furnish a room on a budget

words.enDefinition: furniture packaged in pieces that the buyer assembles

examples.en: We bought flat-pack furniture because it fit in my flatmate's small car.
examples.zh: 我们买的是「平板包装家具」，因为室友的小车能装得下。

examples.en: Flat-pack furniture is easier to carry up the stairs to my room.
examples.zh: 「平板包装家具」比较容易沿楼梯搬到我房间。

words.enDefinition: the process of putting a purchased item together yourself

examples.en: Our new wardrobe requires self-assembly, so I borrowed a screwdriver from the porter.
examples.zh: 新衣柜需要「自行组装」，我就向门房借了把螺丝刀。

examples.en: I chose self-assembly because the store wanted too much to build the bed.
examples.zh: 商家收的装床费太贵，我选了「自行组装」。

words.enDefinition: directions for connecting the parts of an item correctly

examples.en: We found the assembly instructions tucked between the two big cardboard panels.
examples.zh: 我们在两块大纸板之间找到了夹着的「组装说明」。

examples.en: If the assembly instructions are missing, try searching for the model number online.
examples.zh: 如果没有「组装说明」，可以试着上网搜一下型号。

words.enDefinition: paid help putting together the parts of purchased furniture

examples.en: I booked an assembly service because the bunk bed looked difficult to put together.
examples.zh: 那张双层床看上去不好装，我就预约了「组装服务」。

examples.en: The assembly service costs extra, but my flatmates agreed to share the fee.
examples.zh: 「组装服务」要另外收费，但室友们同意一起分担。

words.enDefinition: small pieces used to fasten furniture parts together

examples.en: The assembly hardware came in a little bag taped to the bottom shelf.
examples.zh: 「组装五金件」在一个小袋子里，袋子用胶带贴在最下面的搁板上。

examples.en: Keep the assembly hardware in a labeled bag if you take the desk apart.
examples.zh: 如果拆开书桌，就把「组装五金件」放到贴了标签的袋子里。

words.enDefinition: a small bent tool that turns bolts with hexagonal sockets

examples.en: I found an Allen key in the box with the desk legs.
examples.zh: 我在装书桌腿的盒子里找到了一把「内六角扳手」。

examples.en: We needed a smaller Allen key to finish putting the chair together.
examples.zh: 我们需要一把更小的「内六角扳手」才能装完椅子。

collocations: tighten a bolt with an Allen key

words.enDefinition: a short round peg that aligns two pieces before joining

examples.en: The first dowel pin goes into the small hole beside the screw.
examples.zh: 第一根「定位销」要插进螺丝旁边那个小孔里。

examples.en: A dowel pin rolled under the bed while we were building the bookcase.
examples.zh: 我们装书架时，一根「定位销」滚到了床底下。

words.enDefinition: a round fitting that turns to grip a furniture bolt

examples.en: Turn the cam lock until it grips the bolt underneath the shelf.
examples.zh: 把「偏心连接件」拧到卡住搁板下面的螺栓。

examples.en: I put the cam lock in backwards and had to start again.
examples.zh: 我把「偏心连接件」装反了，只能重新来。

words.enDefinition: a hole into which a screw is designed to fit

examples.en: One screw hole does not line up with the bracket on my desk.
examples.zh: 我书桌上的一个「螺丝孔」对不上支架。

examples.en: The screw hole is hidden by a small sticker on the inside panel.
examples.zh: 内侧板上有张小贴纸，把「螺丝孔」盖住了。

words.enDefinition: tighten a fastener by hand rather than with a tool

examples.en: The instructions say to hand-tighten each bolt before turning the desk upright.
examples.zh: 说明书说，先「用手拧紧」每个螺栓，再把书桌扶正。

examples.en: You can hand-tighten the knobs once both shelf brackets are in place.
examples.zh: 两个隔板支架都装好之后，就可以「用手拧紧」旋钮。

words.enDefinition: supports whose height can be changed to level furniture

examples.en: The adjustable feet keep my desk level on these old floorboards upstairs.
examples.zh: 有了「可调节支脚」，我的书桌放在楼上这些旧木地板上也能保持水平。

examples.en: We put the adjustable feet on before lifting the cabinet into place.
examples.zh: 我们先装好「可调节支脚」，再把柜子抬到预定位置。

collocations: level a cabinet with adjustable feet

words.enDefinition: hardware for anchoring furniture so it cannot tip forward

examples.en: The dresser came with an anti-tip kit so we could anchor it safely.
examples.zh: 抽屉柜带了一套「防倾倒配件」，我们可以把柜子稳妥地固定住。

examples.en: I asked the landlord about using the anti-tip kit on this wall.
examples.zh: 我问了房东能不能在这面墙上安装「防倾倒配件」。

collocations: secure a dresser with an anti-tip kit

words.enDefinition: discs placed under furniture legs to make moving easier

examples.en: I put furniture sliders under the bookcase before moving it across the carpet.
examples.zh: 沿地毯挪书架前，我在书架下面垫了「家具助滑垫」。

examples.en: We used furniture sliders to rearrange the sitting room before our guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前，我们用「家具助滑垫」重新摆了客厅的家具。

collocations: place furniture sliders under the legs
slide a dresser on furniture sliders

words.enDefinition: soft pads under furniture legs that protect the floor

examples.en: I added felt pads to the dining chairs to protect our wooden floor.
examples.zh: 我在餐椅腿上贴了「毛毡脚垫」，以免刮伤木地板。

examples.en: The chair scrapes whenever I move it, so I bought new felt pads.
examples.zh: 椅子一挪就刮地板，所以我买了新的「毛毡脚垫」。

collocations: fit felt pads to chair legs

words.enDefinition: the unobstructed space available through an open doorway

examples.en: We checked the door clearance before buying the sofa from our neighbors.
examples.zh: 从邻居那儿买沙发之前，我们确认了「门洞净空」。

examples.en: I sent the driver the door clearance so he could check the measurements.
examples.zh: 我把「门洞净空」发给司机，好让他核对尺寸。

words.enDefinition: a specific time period assigned for a delivery

examples.en: I chose a delivery slot that starts after my last lecture on Friday.
examples.zh: 我选的「预约送货时段」从周五最后一节课之后开始。

examples.en: We lost our delivery slot when the checkout page froze just before payment.
examples.zh: 付款前结账页面卡住了，我们选的「预约送货时段」就没保住。

words.enDefinition: delivery to the roadside outside an address rather than indoors

examples.en: I chose curbside delivery and asked my flatmate to help move the boxes upstairs.
examples.zh: 我选了「路边交货」，请室友帮我把箱子搬上楼。

examples.en: Curbside delivery was cheaper, but I had to move the table myself.
examples.zh: 「路边交货」比较便宜，不过桌子得我自己搬进来。

words.enDefinition: a service taking an item into a room you choose

examples.en: I paid for room-of-choice delivery because the wardrobe was too heavy to carry upstairs myself.
examples.zh: 衣柜太重，我一个人搬不上楼，于是付费选了「送货至指定房间」。

examples.en: The order includes room-of-choice delivery, so the driver can bring the bed upstairs.
examples.zh: 订单包含「送货至指定房间」，所以司机可以把床搬上楼。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement for collecting an item nearby rather than shipping it

examples.en: The seller offers local pickup at a garage two blocks from campus.
examples.zh: 卖家支持「当地自提」，地点在离学校两个街区的车库。

examples.en: I chose local pickup so I could check the desk before paying.
examples.zh: 我选了「当地自提」，这样付钱前能先看桌子。

collocations: list an item for local pickup

words.enDefinition: available to collect in person with no delivery offered

examples.en: The listing says pickup only, so I need to borrow a car.
examples.zh: 商品页面写着「仅限自提」，所以我得借辆车。

examples.en: All the chairs are pickup only because the seller is moving tomorrow.
examples.zh: 卖家明天就搬家，所以这几把椅子都「仅限自提」。

words.enDefinition: available at no cost to anyone who collects it

examples.en: I found a sofa advertised as free for collection in our neighborhood group.
examples.zh: 我在小区群里看到一张可以「免费自取」的沙发。

examples.en: The shelves are free for collection if you can pick them up by Friday.
examples.zh: 星期五前能搬走的话，这些架子可以「免费自取」。

words.enDefinition: furniture previously owned and used by someone else

examples.en: We bought secondhand furniture so we could spend more on course materials.
examples.zh: 我们买了「二手家具」，这样就能多留些钱买上课的材料。

examples.en: The charity shop sells secondhand furniture and can deliver it for a small fee.
examples.zh: 慈善商店出售「二手家具」，付一点运费就能送货。

words.enDefinition: a sale of belongings by someone preparing to move

examples.en: We found two matching chairs at a moving sale around the corner.
examples.zh: 拐角那家正在「搬家清仓甩卖」，我们在那里淘到了两把一样的椅子。

examples.en: Our neighbors are holding a moving sale before they leave for another city.
examples.zh: 邻居要搬去别的城市，走之前打算办一场「搬家清仓甩卖」。

words.enDefinition: give usable furniture to a charity or community group

examples.en: We plan to donate furniture we cannot take home at the end of term.
examples.zh: 我们打算把学期末带不回家的家具「捐出去」。

examples.en: You can donate furniture to the student reuse scheme near the library.
examples.zh: 你可以把家具「捐给」图书馆附近的学生循环利用项目。

words.enDefinition: the item's current state with no promise to address problems

examples.en: The seller listed the desk in as-is condition and pointed out the scratches.
examples.zh: 卖家声明书桌「按现状出售」，还特意指出了上面的划痕。

examples.en: I accepted the chair in as-is condition after checking that it was sturdy.
examples.zh: 我确认椅子结实后，同意按「现状」买下。

words.enDefinition: previously owned but showing only a little wear

examples.en: I bought a gently used desk from a student who just graduated.
examples.zh: 我从一位刚毕业的学生手里买了张「轻度使用过的」书桌。

examples.en: The photos show a gently used chair with no noticeable marks or stains.
examples.zh: 照片里是一把「轻度使用过的」椅子，没有明显痕迹或污渍。

words.enDefinition: small surface marks from objects rubbing against something

examples.en: The cabinet has minor scuffs, but all the drawers still slide smoothly.
examples.zh: 柜子有几处「轻微擦痕」，不过所有抽屉都还能顺畅推拉。

examples.en: I noticed some minor scuffs on the legs when I picked up the table.
examples.zh: 提起桌子时，我发现桌腿上有几处「轻微擦痕」。

words.enDefinition: a panel attached at the head of a bed

examples.en: The headboard was too wide for the narrow nook in my room.
examples.zh: 「床头板」太宽了，放不进我房间那个窄凹位。

examples.en: I leaned against the padded headboard to read before my roommate woke up.
examples.zh: 室友醒来前，我靠在软包「床头板」上看书。

words.enDefinition: a panel attached at the end of a bed

examples.en: We removed the footboard to make more space at the end of the bed.
examples.zh: 我们拆了「床尾板」，好让床尾多留一点空间。

examples.en: I hit my shin on the footboard when I walked past in the dark.
examples.zh: 我摸黑走过时，小腿撞到了「床尾板」。

words.enDefinition: the structure that supports a mattress above the floor

examples.en: The bed frame fits in my room, but the headboard blocks one socket.
examples.zh: 「床架」放得进我房间，但床头板挡住了一个插座。

examples.en: We sold the bed frame to another student before we moved out.
examples.zh: 搬出去之前，我们把「床架」卖给了另一个学生。

words.enDefinition: strips supporting the mattress across the width of a bed frame

examples.en: The bed slats were bundled separately at the bottom of the box.
examples.zh: 「床板条」单独捆成一束，放在箱子底下。

examples.en: The store sells replacement bed slats for the most common sizes of bed.
examples.zh: 这家店有几种常见床尺寸配套的替换「床板条」。

words.enDefinition: a bed with a base that supports a mattress directly

examples.en: I chose a platform bed so I would not need a separate box spring.
examples.zh: 我选了「平台床」，这样不用另外买弹簧床座。

examples.en: The platform bed is low enough for the attic room I rent.
examples.zh: 「平台床」够矮，放得进我租的阁楼房间。

words.enDefinition: a sprung base placed underneath a mattress for support

examples.en: The box spring and mattress were too bulky to fit in our van.
examples.zh: 「弹簧床座」和床垫太占地方，我们的面包车装不下。

examples.en: Ask whether the bed frame can support a mattress without a box spring.
examples.zh: 问问这个床架不用「弹簧床座」能不能撑住床垫。

words.enDefinition: two beds stacked one above the other

examples.en: A bunk bed gave us enough floor space for two desks in the room.
examples.zh: 用了「双层床」，房间的地面空间才够摆两张桌子。

examples.en: My sister always picked the top of the bunk bed when she visited.
examples.zh: 姐姐来做客时，总想睡「双层床」的上铺。

collocations: the top of the bunk bed

words.enDefinition: a raised bed with usable open space below it

examples.en: I put my desk under the loft bed to make room for a chair.
examples.zh: 我把书桌搬到「高架床」下，腾出地方放椅子。

examples.en: The ceiling is too low for a loft bed in this attic room.
examples.zh: 这间阁楼房的天花板太低，放不了「高架床」。

collocations: put a desk under a loft bed

words.enDefinition: a bed designed to double as seating during the day

examples.en: We put a daybed in the living room for guests who stay over.
examples.zh: 我们在客厅放了张「两用坐卧床」，方便客人留宿。

examples.en: I use the daybed as a sofa when friends come around after class.
examples.zh: 朋友下课过来时，我把「两用坐卧床」当沙发用。

collocations: use a daybed as a sofa

words.enDefinition: a low bed stored underneath another bed and pulled out

examples.en: My cousin slept on the trundle bed when she toured our campus last weekend.
examples.zh: 表妹上周末来参观我们学校时，睡的是「抽拉床」。

examples.en: We can pull out the trundle bed when the spare room is already taken.
examples.zh: 备用房间已经有人住时，我们可以拉出「抽拉床」。

collocations: a daybed with a trundle bed

words.enDefinition: a bed that folds up for storage when unused

examples.en: We keep a foldaway bed behind the wardrobe for friends who miss the last train.
examples.zh: 我们在衣柜后备了一张「折叠收纳床」，给赶不上末班车的朋友用。

examples.en: The foldaway bed came in handy when my parents visited for graduation.
examples.zh: 父母来参加毕业典礼时，「折叠收纳床」派上了用场。

words.enDefinition: a mattress filled with air when needed for sleeping

examples.en: I slept on an air mattress until my new bed was delivered.
examples.zh: 我的新床送到之前，我一直睡「充气床垫」。

examples.en: We keep an air mattress in the cupboard for visitors during term.
examples.zh: 我们把一张「充气床垫」收在柜子里，留给学期中来访的客人。

words.enDefinition: a US single mattress with extra length for one sleeper

examples.en: My residence hall uses a twin XL mattress in every single room.
examples.zh: 我住的宿舍楼，每间单人房都配「加长单人床垫」。

examples.en: These sheets won't fit a twin XL mattress, so I returned them.
examples.zh: 这些床单套不上「加长单人床垫」，我就退了。

collocations: sheets for a twin XL mattress

words.enDefinition: a mattress made with foam that molds to the body

examples.en: The memory foam mattress came rolled up in a surprisingly small box.
examples.zh: 「记忆棉床垫」是卷起来装的，箱子小得出乎意料。

examples.en: I tried a memory foam mattress in the shop before ordering one online.
examples.zh: 我先去店里试了「记忆棉床垫」，再上网下单。

collocations: sleep on a memory foam mattress

words.enDefinition: a mattress with springs enclosed separately in fabric pockets

examples.en: The pocket spring mattress felt firmer than the foam one beside it.
examples.zh: 这张「独立袋装弹簧床垫」摸起来比旁边的泡沫床垫硬一些。

examples.en: My flatmate suggested a pocket spring mattress for the bed in my new room.
examples.zh: 室友建议我新房间的床用「独立袋装弹簧床垫」。

collocations: shop for a pocket spring mattress

words.enDefinition: a covering that shields a mattress from moisture and stains

examples.en: I bought a mattress protector before bringing my coffee anywhere near the bed.
examples.zh: 我先买了「床垫保护套」，这才敢把咖啡端到床边。

examples.en: The hall cleaner gave us a new mattress protector at the start of term.
examples.zh: 开学时，宿舍保洁员给了我们一个新的「床垫保护套」。

words.enDefinition: a sheet with elastic edges that grip the mattress

examples.en: The fitted sheet keeps slipping off because this mattress is unusually thick.
examples.zh: 这张床垫特别厚，「床笠」老是从边上滑下来。

examples.en: I bought a fitted sheet before my first night in the residence hall.
examples.zh: 第一晚住宿舍之前，我买了一个「床笠」。

words.enDefinition: a rectangular bed sheet without elastic around the edges

examples.en: I layered a flat sheet under the blanket because the room was cold.
examples.zh: 房间有点冷，我在毯子底下又铺了条「无松紧床单」。

examples.en: A flat sheet is easier to fold than the one with elastic corners.
examples.zh: 「无松紧床单」比四角有松紧带的床笠好叠。

words.enDefinition: coordinated sheets and usually pillowcases sold as one set

examples.en: My aunt bought me a sheet set as a present for moving into residence.
examples.zh: 姨妈送了我一套「床单套装」，当作搬进宿舍的礼物。

examples.en: The sheet set includes one pillowcase, so I ordered a spare separately.
examples.zh: 「床单套装」只带一个枕套，所以我另外买了个备用的。

words.enDefinition: fabric hanging from the bed base to conceal storage underneath

examples.en: I used a bed skirt to hide the boxes underneath the bed.
examples.zh: 我用「床裙」遮住了床底下的箱子。

examples.en: The bed skirt is long enough to cover the metal frame in my room.
examples.zh: 「床裙」够长，能把我房间床的金属床架遮住。

collocations: hide boxes behind a bed skirt

words.enDefinition: a protective cover worn under the outer pillowcase

examples.en: I washed the pillow protector along with the sheets before my guest arrived.
examples.zh: 客人来之前，我把「枕芯保护套」和床单一起洗了。

examples.en: The pillow protector goes under the pillowcase and closes with a small zipper.
examples.zh: 「枕芯保护套」套在枕套里面，有个小拉链可以拉上。

words.enDefinition: a decorative cover spread over a made bed

examples.en: I put a light bedspread on the bed before the room inspection.
examples.zh: 宿舍检查前，我在床上铺了一条薄「床罩」。

examples.en: The bedspread was too big for our shared washing machine in the basement.
examples.zh: 「床罩」太大，地下室的公用洗衣机放不下。

collocations: spread a bedspread over the bed

words.enDefinition: a light warm blanket made of soft fuzzy fabric

examples.en: I keep a fleece blanket on my chair for cold evenings at my desk.
examples.zh: 我在椅子上放了条「绒毯」，晚上坐在书桌前冷的时候用。

examples.en: We bought a fleece blanket for guests who sleep on the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们买了条「绒毯」，给睡沙发的客人用。

collocations: wrap up in a fleece blanket

words.enDefinition: a blanket filled with weights to create gentle pressure

examples.en: My weighted blanket was too heavy to take home in my carry-on bag.
examples.zh: 我的「加重毯」太沉，放进随身行李带不回家。

examples.en: I bought a weighted blanket with a cover I could wash separately.
examples.zh: 我买了条「加重毯」，外套可以拆下来单独洗。

words.enDefinition: blocks fitted under bed legs to raise the frame

examples.en: I used bed risers to make space for two boxes underneath my bed.
examples.zh: 我用了「床脚增高垫」，在床下面腾出了放两个箱子的空间。

examples.en: The hall rules say we need permission before we add bed risers.
examples.zh: 宿舍规定说，加装「床脚增高垫」之前要先获得许可。

collocations: raise the frame with bed risers

words.enDefinition: space or containers for keeping belongings under a bed

examples.en: I use under-bed storage for the winter coats I won't need until November.
examples.zh: 我把十一月之前用不到的冬衣放进了「床下收纳区」。

examples.en: Our room has under-bed storage, so we don't need another chest of drawers.
examples.zh: 我们房间可以「在床下收纳」，所以不用再买抽屉柜。

words.enDefinition: a bed with compartments or drawers built into its frame

examples.en: I chose a storage bed because there was no room for a wardrobe.
examples.zh: 房间里没地方放衣柜，所以我选了一张「收纳床」。

examples.en: The storage bed has drawers I can open from either side of the frame.
examples.zh: 这张「收纳床」带抽屉，从两侧都能拉开。

words.enDefinition: a bed with a lift-up mattress base above storage

examples.en: The mattress on our ottoman bed lifts to reveal space for two suitcases.
examples.zh: 我们的「上翻收纳床」掀起床垫后，下面能放两个行李箱。

examples.en: I chose an ottoman bed because side drawers would hit my desk.
examples.zh: 侧边的抽屉会碰到书桌，所以我选了「上翻收纳床」。

collocations: lift the base of an ottoman bed
an ottoman bed with a gas lift

words.enDefinition: a small blanket draped over seating for style and warmth

examples.en: My flatmate draped a throw blanket over the corner of our old sofa.
examples.zh: 室友在旧沙发的一角搭了条「装饰小毯」。

examples.en: I pulled the throw blanket over my knees while we watched the film.
examples.zh: 看电影时，我把「装饰小毯」盖在了膝盖上。

words.enDefinition: a small decorative cushion placed on a bed or sofa

examples.en: I added a throw pillow to make the sofa feel less bare.
examples.zh: 我加了个「装饰抱枕」，这样沙发就没那么空了。

examples.en: My roommate picked a yellow throw pillow to match the rug we bought.
examples.zh: 室友挑了一个黄色「装饰抱枕」，和我们买的地毯搭配。

collocations: arrange a throw pillow on the sofa

words.enDefinition: a removable fabric case covering a cushion

examples.en: I slipped the cushion cover off after someone spilled coffee on the sofa.
examples.zh: 有人把咖啡洒在沙发上，我就把「靠垫套」拆了下来。

examples.en: This cushion cover fits the old insert, so I didn't buy a new one.
examples.zh: 这个「靠垫套」的尺寸适合旧靠垫芯，所以我没再买新的。

words.enDefinition: a padded footstool with a compartment inside

examples.en: I keep spare bedding inside the storage ottoman beside my bedroom door.
examples.zh: 我把备用床品放在卧室门边的「储物脚凳」里。

examples.en: The storage ottoman doubles as an extra seat when friends come around.
examples.zh: 朋友来时，「储物脚凳」还能当一个额外的座位。

collocations: lift the lid of a storage ottoman

words.enDefinition: a long seat with space inside or underneath for belongings

examples.en: I put a storage bench by the door to hold shoes and bags.
examples.zh: 我在门边放了张「储物长凳」，用来放鞋和包。

examples.en: We needed a narrow storage bench so the hallway would stay clear.
examples.zh: 为了让走廊不碍事，我们需要一张窄点的「储物长凳」。

collocations: a storage bench with a lid

words.enDefinition: containers designed to sit securely on top of each other

examples.en: We used stackable storage bins to make better use of the closet space.
examples.zh: 我们用了「可堆叠收纳箱」，把壁橱的空间利用得更充分。

examples.en: The stackable storage bins hold notebooks from all four years of university.
examples.zh: 这些「可堆叠收纳箱」里装着我大学四年的笔记本。

words.enDefinition: a small wheeled shelving unit for holding everyday items

examples.en: My rolling storage cart fits between the desk and the foot of the bed.
examples.zh: 我的「带轮收纳车」刚好能塞在书桌和床尾之间。

examples.en: We use a rolling storage cart for art supplies in our shared studio.
examples.zh: 我们在共用工作室里用「带轮收纳车」装美术用品。

words.enDefinition: pieces that separate a drawer into smaller compartments

examples.en: The drawer dividers keep my socks separate from the rest of my clothes.
examples.zh: 「抽屉分隔板」让我能把袜子和其他衣服分开放。

examples.en: I cut the drawer dividers to fit the narrow top drawer properly.
examples.zh: 我把「抽屉分隔板」裁短，正好装进最上面那个窄抽屉。

words.enDefinition: a holder with compartments that hangs from a support

examples.en: The hanging organizer gives me several small shelves without taking up floor space.
examples.zh: 「悬挂式收纳架」给我多添了几层小搁板，还不占地儿。

examples.en: I use a hanging organizer for shoes in my tiny dorm closet.
examples.zh: 我的宿舍衣柜很小，就用「悬挂式收纳架」放鞋。

words.enDefinition: a freestanding frame with a bar for hanging clothing

examples.en: I bought a garment rack because this room doesn't have a closet.
examples.zh: 房间没有衣柜，所以我买了个「落地挂衣架」。

examples.en: We put our coats on the garment rack when the hall closet filled up.
examples.zh: 门厅的壁橱满了，我们就把外套挂到「落地挂衣架」上。

collocations: hang clothes on a garment rack

words.enDefinition: a freestanding or wall-mounted frame holding several shelves

examples.en: The shelving unit fits neatly into the space between our two desks.
examples.zh: 「多层置物架」正好可以放进我们两张桌子之间。

examples.en: I brought my notes upstairs after we finished assembling the shelving unit.
examples.zh: 我们装好「多层置物架」后，我把笔记搬上了楼。

words.enDefinition: shelves mounted to the wall with their supports hidden

examples.en: The floating shelves make room for my plants without covering the desk.
examples.zh: 「隐形支架搁板」给我的植物留了地方，又没占桌面。

examples.en: I asked my landlord before putting up floating shelves in the bedroom.
examples.zh: 在卧室安装「隐形支架搁板」之前，我先问了房东。

words.enDefinition: a shelving unit with shelves arranged like steps on a ladder

examples.en: I put a ladder shelf beside the window for books and plants.
examples.zh: 我在窗边放了个「梯形置物架」，用来放书和植物。

examples.en: The ladder shelf is narrow enough to fit between my desk and door.
examples.zh: 这个「梯形置物架」够窄，能放进书桌和门之间。

collocations: lean a ladder shelf against the wall

words.enDefinition: a shelf designed to use the space where walls meet

examples.en: I keep my clock on a corner shelf next to the bed.
examples.zh: 我把钟放在床边的「转角置物板」上。

examples.en: A corner shelf gave me somewhere to put small plants by the window.
examples.zh: 装了一块「转角置物板」，我就有地方在窗边摆小盆栽了。

words.enDefinition: a protective sheet placed on the surface of a shelf

examples.en: I cut the shelf liner to fit the narrow shelves in the hall cupboard.
examples.zh: 我把「搁板垫」裁成合适的大小，铺在门厅柜子的窄搁板上。

examples.en: We put down shelf liner so the mugs wouldn't slide around when we opened the cabinet.
examples.zh: 我们铺了「搁板垫」，这样开柜门时马克杯就不会滑动。

words.enDefinition: a movable wardrobe that is separate from the wall structure

examples.en: I chose a freestanding wardrobe so I could take it when I moved.
examples.zh: 我选了「独立式衣柜」，这样搬家时还能带走。

examples.en: The freestanding wardrobe blocks the socket unless we move it toward the door.
examples.zh: 除非把「独立式衣柜」往门那边挪一挪，否则它会挡住插座。

words.enDefinition: a piece of furniture containing a stack of drawers

examples.en: My room came with a small chest of drawers under the window.
examples.zh: 我房间里原本在窗下配了个小「抽屉柜」。

examples.en: We moved the chest of drawers into the hall to make more floor space.
examples.zh: 我们把「抽屉柜」搬到门厅，腾出了更多地面空间。

collocations: put clothes in a chest of drawers

words.enDefinition: a small table or cabinet beside a bed

examples.en: I leave my glasses on the nightstand so I can find them at night.
examples.zh: 我把眼镜放在「床头柜」上，晚上好找。

examples.en: The nightstand has two drawers, so I use one for spare chargers.
examples.zh: 「床头柜」有两个抽屉，我用其中一个放备用充电器。

collocations: put a lamp on the nightstand

words.enDefinition: a small table placed beside the end of a sofa

examples.en: There is an end table where you can set your cup of tea.
examples.zh: 旁边有个「沙发边几」，你的茶杯可以放上面。

examples.en: I bought a secondhand end table for the corner beside our sofa.
examples.zh: 我买了个二手「沙发边几」，放在我们沙发旁的角落。

collocations: set a drink on the end table
an end table beside the sofa

words.enDefinition: a low table usually placed in front of a sofa

examples.en: We moved the coffee table closer to the couch for our board game.
examples.zh: 为了玩桌游，我们把「茶几」挪得离沙发近一点。

examples.en: I left my library books on the coffee table in the living room.
examples.zh: 我把从图书馆借的书落在客厅的「茶几」上了。

collocations: set drinks on the coffee table

words.enDefinition: a table with hinged sides that fold down to save space

examples.en: We use a drop-leaf table because our kitchen has very little room.
examples.zh: 厨房很窄，所以我们用的是「折板桌」。

examples.en: We open the drop-leaf table when friends come over for Sunday lunch.
examples.zh: 朋友周日来吃午饭时，我们会展开「折板桌」。

collocations: open both sides of a drop-leaf table

words.enDefinition: a table that can be made longer when needed

examples.en: I found an extendable table that seats six when the extra leaf is in.
examples.zh: 我找到一张「可加长桌」，加上加长板之后可以坐六个人。

examples.en: The extendable table stays small until we need it for a group meal.
examples.zh: 平时「可加长桌」都收着，聚餐时才把它加长。

collocations: fit an extra leaf into an extendable table

words.enDefinition: a table that folds up when it is not needed

examples.en: I set up a folding table when our study group needed more space.
examples.zh: 学习小组需要更多地方，我就支了一张「折叠桌」。

examples.en: The folding table fits behind my door when we are not using it.
examples.zh: 不用的时候，「折叠桌」可以收在我的房门后面。

words.enDefinition: a chair whose frame folds flat for easy storage

examples.en: I keep a folding chair behind the wardrobe for anyone who drops by.
examples.zh: 我在衣柜后面放了一把「折叠椅」，有人顺路来坐坐就能用。

examples.en: The folding chair is lighter than our spare dining chair and easier to carry.
examples.zh: 「折叠椅」比我们备用的餐椅轻，搬起来也容易。

words.enDefinition: a chair shaped to stack neatly with other matching chairs

examples.en: The stacking chair can sit on top of the other chairs after dinner.
examples.zh: 吃完饭后，可以把这把「可叠放椅」摞到别的椅子上。

examples.en: We picked a stacking chair because our shared kitchen has little storage space.
examples.zh: 公用厨房没多少收纳空间，所以我们挑了一把「可叠放椅」。

collocations: buy a set of stacking chairs

words.enDefinition: a comfortable chair with supports for the arms

examples.en: I found a comfortable armchair in the secondhand shop near the bus stop.
examples.zh: 我在公交站附近的二手店找到了一把舒服的「扶手椅」。

examples.en: My flatmate reads in the armchair while I work at the kitchen table.
examples.zh: 我在厨房桌前学习，室友在「扶手椅」里看书。

collocations: place an armchair by the window

words.enDefinition: a chair whose back tilts and often has a footrest

examples.en: The secondhand recliner was too wide to fit through our front door.
examples.zh: 那把二手「可躺座椅」太宽，进不了我们家大门。

examples.en: My roommate found a recliner that folds down enough for an afternoon nap.
examples.zh: 室友找到一把能放倒到可以睡午觉的「可躺座椅」。

words.enDefinition: a low stool used to support a seated person's feet

examples.en: I put a footstool in front of the armchair beside my bedroom window.
examples.zh: 我在卧室窗边的扶手椅前面放了一个「脚凳」。

examples.en: The footstool slides under the chair when I need to clear the floor.
examples.zh: 要把地面腾出来的时候，可以把「脚凳」推到椅子底下。

collocations: put your feet on a footstool

words.enDefinition: a soft chair filled with small beads that shifts shape

examples.en: I read in the beanbag chair because there is no room for a sofa.
examples.zh: 没地方摆沙发，所以我就窝在「豆袋椅」里看书。

examples.en: The beanbag chair was light enough to carry to my room alone.
examples.zh: 「豆袋椅」很轻，我自己就能搬进房间。

words.enDefinition: a high seat designed for use at a tall counter

examples.en: I eat breakfast on a bar stool at our narrow kitchen counter.
examples.zh: 我坐在「吧台凳」上，就着厨房窄窄的台面吃早饭。

examples.en: We bought a second bar stool so my flatmate could sit there too.
examples.zh: 我们又买了一把「吧台凳」，这样室友也能坐那里。

words.enDefinition: a compact sofa with room for two people

examples.en: The loveseat gives us somewhere to sit without taking up the whole room.
examples.zh: 有了「双人小沙发」，我们有地方坐，又不会把整间房占满。

examples.en: My roommate found a gray loveseat that would fit under the window.
examples.zh: 室友找到了一张能放在窗下的灰色「双人小沙发」。

words.enDefinition: a sofa that opens or folds out into a bed

examples.en: My cousin slept on the sofa bed when she came for graduation.
examples.zh: 表妹来参加毕业典礼时，睡的是「沙发床」。

examples.en: We fold the sofa bed away each morning to free up the living room.
examples.zh: 每天早上我们都把「沙发床」收起来，腾出客厅的空间。

words.enDefinition: a sofa made of separate sections arranged together

examples.en: The sectional sofa came in two pieces, which made it easier to carry upstairs.
examples.zh: 「组合沙发」分为两块，搬上楼容易一些。

examples.en: Our sectional sofa fits into the corner without blocking the balcony door.
examples.zh: 我们家的「组合沙发」正好放在角落里，不会挡住阳台门。

words.enDefinition: a removable fabric cover fitted loosely over furniture

examples.en: We put a slipcover on the sofa to hide the old stains.
examples.zh: 我们给沙发套了个「可拆卸家具罩」，把旧污渍遮起来。

examples.en: I washed the slipcover before handing the living room back to the landlord.
examples.zh: 把客厅交还房东之前，我把「可拆卸家具罩」洗了。

words.enDefinition: a chair whose seat turns around its vertical support

examples.en: The swivel chair lets me turn from the desk to the shelves.
examples.zh: 坐在「旋转椅」上，我可以从书桌边转向置物架。

examples.en: I bought a swivel chair that fits underneath my desk when pushed in.
examples.zh: 我买了一把推到底就能收进桌底的「旋转椅」。

words.enDefinition: a chair with an open-weave fabric seat or back

examples.en: The mesh chair felt cooler than the padded one during the afternoon.
examples.zh: 下午天气热的时候，「网布椅」坐起来比软垫椅凉快。

examples.en: I found a secondhand mesh chair for my desk at the campus fair.
examples.zh: 我在校园集市上找到了一把二手「网布椅」，配我的书桌用。

collocations: a mesh chair with lumbar support

words.enDefinition: a chair designed to support the body during prolonged sitting

examples.en: I tried the ergonomic chair at the store before buying it online.
examples.zh: 我在店里试坐了这把「人体工学椅」，之后才在网上下单。

examples.en: My flatmate bought an ergonomic chair because she studies at home most days.
examples.zh: 室友大多数时候在家里学习，所以买了一把「人体工学椅」。

collocations: an ergonomic chair for a home office

words.enDefinition: a desk designed for work while standing up

examples.en: I use a standing desk for video calls because I like to move around.
examples.zh: 视频通话时我喜欢活动活动，就用「站立式书桌」。

examples.en: The standing desk is too tall for my chair at its highest setting.
examples.zh: 「站立式书桌」调到最高时，我坐椅子就够不着了。

words.enDefinition: a simple desk with a flat surface for writing

examples.en: A small writing desk fits under the window in my rented room.
examples.zh: 我租的房间窗下能摆一张小「写字台」。

examples.en: The writing desk has one shallow drawer where I keep paper and envelopes.
examples.zh: 「写字台」有一个浅抽屉，我把纸张和信封放在里面。

words.enDefinition: a desk shaped to make use of a room corner

examples.en: I chose a corner desk to keep the center of my room clear.
examples.zh: 我选了「转角书桌」，这样房间中间就不会被占。

examples.en: The corner desk gives me enough space for my laptop and sketchbook.
examples.zh: 「转角书桌」面积够大，能同时放下笔记本电脑和速写本。

collocations: fit a corner desk into a room

words.enDefinition: a desk whose work surface folds down from a support

examples.en: We installed a fold-down desk so the bedroom door could still open fully.
examples.zh: 我们装了张「下翻式书桌」，这样卧室门还能完全打开。

examples.en: I use the fold-down desk for homework and close it before having friends over.
examples.zh: 我打开「下翻式书桌」写作业，朋友来之前再把它合上。

words.enDefinition: the distance from the floor to the seat of a chair

examples.en: I adjusted the seat height so my feet could rest on the floor.
examples.zh: 我调整了「座面高度」，让双脚能平放在地上。

examples.en: The seat height is too low for the desk that came with my room.
examples.zh: 对房间原配的书桌来说，这个「座面高度」太低了。

words.enDefinition: arm supports that can be moved to different positions

examples.en: The adjustable armrests slide down so my chair fits under the desk.
examples.zh: 「可调扶手」能往下滑，这样椅子就能推进书桌下面。

examples.en: I looked for adjustable armrests when comparing chairs at the secondhand shop.
examples.zh: 在二手店比较几把椅子时，我特意找带「可调扶手」的。

words.enDefinition: a chair feature that supports the lower back

examples.en: The chair has lumbar support, which I can move higher or lower.
examples.zh: 这把椅子有「腰部支撑」，我可以把它往上或往下调。

examples.en: I wanted some lumbar support for the chair I use during long study sessions.
examples.zh: 我长时间学习时坐的椅子，需要一点「腰部支撑」。

words.enDefinition: a protective floor covering placed underneath a rolling chair

examples.en: I bought a chair mat to protect the wooden floor under my desk.
examples.zh: 我买了块「座椅地垫」，保护书桌下面的木地板。

examples.en: The chair mat makes it easier to move my desk chair across the carpet.
examples.zh: 有了「座椅地垫」，我的书桌椅更容易在地毯上滑动。

words.enDefinition: small wheels fitted with brakes to keep furniture stationary

examples.en: The storage cart has locking casters so it stays next to my desk.
examples.zh: 收纳车装了「带锁脚轮」，能稳稳停在书桌旁。

examples.en: I checked the locking casters before putting heavy books on the rolling shelf.
examples.zh: 把重书放到带轮书架上之前，我检查了「带锁脚轮」。

words.enDefinition: a platform used to raise a computer screen

examples.en: My monitor stand leaves enough room to slide the keyboard underneath after class.
examples.zh: 下课后，我可以把键盘推进「显示器增高架」下的空位。

examples.en: I use a monitor stand because the screen sits too low on my desk.
examples.zh: 显示器放在书桌上太低了，所以我用了「显示器增高架」。

words.enDefinition: a container with sections for small items on a desk

examples.en: I put a desk organizer by my laptop for pencils and sticky notes.
examples.zh: 我在笔记本电脑旁放了个「桌面收纳盒」，装铅笔和便利贴。

examples.en: The desk organizer has a narrow slot that fits my calculator perfectly.
examples.zh: 「桌面收纳盒」有个窄槽，我的计算器放进去正合适。

collocations: sort pens into a desk organizer

words.enDefinition: a cabinet with drawers for storing and organizing documents

examples.en: The small filing cabinet holds my tenancy papers and old course notes.
examples.zh: 这个小「文件柜」装着我的租房文件和旧课程笔记。

examples.en: We found a filing cabinet that was narrow enough to fit beside our desk.
examples.zh: 我们找到一个够窄的「文件柜」，能摆在书桌旁。

collocations: store papers in a filing cabinet

words.enDefinition: a fitting lining a hole through which cables pass

examples.en: I threaded the charger through the cable grommet at the back of the desk.
examples.zh: 我把充电线从书桌后侧的「穿线孔套」里穿了过去。

examples.en: The cable grommet was too small for the plug on my monitor.
examples.zh: 「穿线孔套」太小了，显示器的插头穿不过去。

collocations: feed wires through a cable grommet

words.enDefinition: a channel or rack used to hold and route cables

examples.en: My flatmate installed a cable tray underneath our desk to clear the floor.
examples.zh: 室友在书桌下面装了「理线槽」，把地上的线收了起来。

examples.en: The cable tray keeps my power strip out of reach of the cat.
examples.zh: 「理线槽」把插线板收了起来，猫就够不着了。

collocations: hide wires in a cable tray

words.enDefinition: a tall lamp that stands directly on the floor

examples.en: I put a floor lamp by the sofa for reading after dinner.
examples.zh: 我在沙发旁放了一盏「落地灯」，方便晚饭后看书。

examples.en: The floor lamp lights up the corner that the ceiling light never reaches.
examples.zh: 天花板上的灯照不到那个角落，「落地灯」刚好能照亮那里。

collocations: stand a floor lamp by the sofa

words.enDefinition: a lamp that fastens to an edge with a clip

examples.en: We bought a clip-on lamp because the bedside table was already full.
examples.zh: 床头柜已经放满了，所以我们买了一盏「夹式灯」。

examples.en: I attached a clip-on lamp to the shelf above my desk for reading.
examples.zh: 我在书桌上方的搁板上夹了一盏「夹式灯」看书用。

words.enDefinition: a rug that covers part of a room's floor

examples.en: We put an area rug under the coffee table to soften the room.
examples.zh: 我们在茶几下面铺了一张「块毯」，让房间看起来更温馨。

examples.en: The area rug is small enough to roll up when I move out.
examples.zh: 这张「块毯」不大，搬走时可以卷起来。

collocations: place an area rug under the sofa

words.enDefinition: a layer placed underneath a rug to keep it still

examples.en: We added a rug pad after the carpet kept shifting on the tiles.
examples.zh: 地毯在瓷砖地上总跑位，我们就加了「地毯防滑垫」。

examples.en: I cut the rug pad so it wouldn't stick out around the edges.
examples.zh: 我把「地毯防滑垫」裁小了一圈，这样边缘就不会露出来。

collocations: cut a rug pad to size

words.enDefinition: a long narrow rug used in a hallway or aisle

examples.en: We found a runner rug wide enough for the narrow hallway upstairs.
examples.zh: 我们找到一块「长条地毯」，宽度刚好适合楼上的狭窄走廊。

examples.en: The runner rug stops the floor feeling cold on early mornings in winter.
examples.zh: 冬天一大早，「长条地毯」让地面踩起来没那么冰。

words.enDefinition: curtains designed to block nearly all light entering a room

examples.en: I hung blackout curtains because the streetlight shines directly into my room.
examples.zh: 因为路灯直照进我房间，我挂了「遮光窗帘」。

examples.en: The blackout curtains kept the room dark enough for me to sleep late.
examples.zh: 「遮光窗帘」让房间一直很暗，我可以多睡一会儿。

words.enDefinition: thin curtains that let some light through

examples.en: The sheer curtains let enough daylight through for the plants by my window.
examples.zh: 窗边的植物隔着「纱帘」也能晒到足够的阳光。

examples.en: We chose sheer curtains to keep the living room bright in the mornings.
examples.zh: 我们选了「纱帘」，让客厅早上也能保持明亮。

collocations: layer sheer curtains behind heavier curtains

words.enDefinition: a bar across a window that holds curtains up

examples.en: I measured the curtain rod before ordering curtains for my new bedroom.
examples.zh: 给新卧室订窗帘之前，我量了「窗帘杆」的长度。

examples.en: The curtain rod was already there, so I just bought two panels.
examples.zh: 原来就有「窗帘杆」，所以我只买了两片帘布。

collocations: hang curtains from a curtain rod

words.enDefinition: an adjustable rod held between two surfaces by pressure

examples.en: I used a tension rod because my landlord doesn't allow drilling holes.
examples.zh: 因为房东不允许打孔，我就用了「撑压式伸缩杆」。

examples.en: We put a tension rod across the bedroom alcove and hung a curtain.
examples.zh: 我们在凹位两侧撑了一根「撑压式伸缩杆」，再把帘子挂上去。

collocations: hang curtains on a tension rod

words.enDefinition: a window covering that coils around a horizontal tube

examples.en: I pulled the roller blind down to stop the glare on my screen.
examples.zh: 我拉下「卷帘」，免得屏幕反光。

examples.en: The roller blind fits inside the frame and leaves the windowsill free.
examples.zh: 「卷帘」装在窗框里，不会占窗台的地方。

words.enDefinition: hooks that hang over the top edge of a door

examples.en: I put over-the-door hooks on the closet door to hang my bags.
examples.zh: 我在衣柜门上装了「门顶挂钩」，用来挂包。

examples.en: The over-the-door hooks fit without stopping the bedroom door from closing properly.
examples.zh: 「门顶挂钩」卡得进去，也不影响卧室门正常关上。

words.enDefinition: a mirror tall enough to reflect someone's whole body

examples.en: I borrowed a full-length mirror to check my outfit before the interview.
examples.zh: 面试前我借了一面「全身镜」，照了照自己的穿搭。

examples.en: The full-length mirror in the hallway makes the narrow space look bigger.
examples.zh: 走廊里的「全身镜」让狭窄的空间显得更大。

collocations: lean a full-length mirror against the wall
stand in front of a full-length mirror

words.enDefinition: a movable panel arrangement that folds up and provides privacy

examples.en: We used a folding screen to give guests privacy in the living room.
examples.zh: 我们在客厅摆了「折叠屏风」，给客人留点私人空间。

examples.en: I moved the folding screen out of the way before our study group arrived.
examples.zh: 学习小组来之前，我把「折叠屏风」挪到了一边。

words.enDefinition: a reusable soft adhesive for hanging lightweight pictures or paper

examples.en: I used poster putty to hang my timetable above the desk without nails.
examples.zh: 我用「海报黏胶泥」把课表贴在桌子上方，不用钉钉子。

examples.en: The poster putty peeled off easily when I cleared the wall at term's end.
examples.zh: 学期结束时我收拾墙面，「海报黏胶泥」很容易就揭下来了。

collocations: press poster putty onto the corners
